ToD_A01_M02_MESS_001.en: Build more Farms to continue unit production.,Build more Pigfarms to continue unit production.,Summon more Ziggurats to continue unit production.,Create more Moon Wells to continue unit production.
ToD_A01_M02_MESS_001.tr: 建造更多的农场来继续生产单位。,建造更多的猪圈来继续生产单位。,召唤更多的通灵塔来继续生产单位。,创造更多的月亮井来继续生产单位。

ToD_A01_M02_MESS_004.en:
|cff32CD32HINT|r 
While your peons are busy building your basecamp, you can send your heroes to scout the surrounding area. Be careful though, as you never want to leave your camp completely undefended.
ToD_A01_M02_MESS_004.tr:
|cff32CD32提示|r 
当你的苦工在基地里大兴土木时，你可以派遣英雄在周边地区侦察。但请当心，千万别让你的基地毫无防备。

ToD_A01_M02_MESS_005.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Troll Axe thrower. Skillful ranged warrior, that can be trained in barracks. Able to attack ground and air targets.
ToD_A01_M02_MESS_005.tr:
|cffffcc00新单位可用|r
巨魔掷斧者。熟练的远程战士，可在兵营中训练。能攻击地面和空中单位。

ToD_A01_M02_MESS_006.en:
|cffffcc00TECHTREE UNLOCKED|r
Troll lumber mill. Serves as a warehouse for harvested lumber. It also contains upgrades for your troll units and the lumber gathering of your peons.
ToD_A01_M02_MESS_006.tr:
|cffffcc00新建筑可用|r
巨魔伐木场。可作为采集木材的卸货点。其中还包括了巨魔单位和木材采集的相关升级。

ToD_A01_M02_MESS_007.en:

  - Destroy the Farms

ToD_A01_M02_MESS_008.en:
|cff32CD32HINT|r 
Fallen hero can be revived in the Great Hall.
ToD_A01_M02_MESS_008.tr:
|cff32CD32提示|r 
受伤的英雄可在大厅中复活。

ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_002.en: This region is home to a strong human garrison. In order to successfully rescue Zul’jin, you will need a powerful force of your own.
ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_002.tr: 该地区被人类重兵把守。为了营救祖尔金，你需要一支强大的武装力量。

ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_008.en: Zul’jin, chieftain of the forest trolls, has been captured by the humans and their elven allies. Free him, and escort him to the safety of the nearby troll village.
ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_008.tr: 森林巨魔酋长——祖尔金，已被人类及其高等精灵盟友俘获。解救他，并将其护送至附近安全的巨魔村落。

ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_010.en: Escort him to the Troll Village

ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_017.en: While rescuing Zul’jin is your highest priority, the power of Durnholde Keep remains a concern. Destroying the prison outpost will go a long way in weakening the fortress and delay any efforts to recapture Zul’jin.
ToD_A01_M02_OBJE_017.tr: 虽然营救祖尔金是头等大事，但强大的敦霍尔德城堡同样是你的心头之患。摧毁监狱岗哨将大大削弱城堡方面的力量，并延缓其缉拿祖尔金的进展。
